name: Southern Sun Limited
summary: Southern Sun Limited owns, leases, and manages hotels in South Africa, Mozambique, the Seychelles, Tanzania, the United Arab Emirates, and Zambia. It operates in four segments: Manco, Sandton Consortium, SA Portfolio, and Offshore. The company operates hotels and resorts under the Southern Sun Hotels, Southern Sun Resorts, StayEasy, Garden Court, SUN1, SunSquare, and Sandton Convention Centre brands, as well as Arabella Hotel, Golf & Spa, Mount Grace Hotel & Spa, Sandton Sun & Towers, Beverly Hills, 54 on Bath, and Paradise Sun brands.
